questions.title: Is there a Fire Safety Plan for the building that has been reviewed within the last 12 months?
questions.instructions: National Fire Code of Canada (NFC) Division B, Section 2.8 / provincial fire code. The plan must reflect current occupancy, staff and systems.

followUps.title: Date of last review, test or exercise (YYYY-MM-DD)

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Review and update the Fire Safety Plan; submit to the fire department where required

questions.title: Is a copy of the Fire Safety Plan kept where the fire department expects it (e.g. fire safety plan box at the main entrance)?
questions.instructions: Location as approved by the local fire department.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Place a current copy of the Fire Safety Plan in the approved location

questions.title: Are floor plans showing exits, pull stations and extinguishers posted on each floor?
questions.instructions: Typically posted near elevators and exit stairs.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Post current fire safety floor plans on every floor

questions.title: Have supervisory staff and fire wardens been trained on their Fire Safety Plan duties, with records kept?
questions.instructions: Training records should show names, date and content.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Train supervisory staff and wardens; record attendance

questions.title: Are inspection, testing and maintenance records for all fire protection systems kept on site for at least the past 2 years?
questions.instructions: NFC requires records to be retained and available to the fire department.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Collect missing service reports and set up the on-site fire log book

questions.title: Has a fire drill been held within the frequency required for this occupancy (at least once a year for most buildings)?
questions.instructions: NFC 2.8.3. Some occupancies (e.g. high-rise, care, schools) require more frequent drills.

followUps.title: Date of last review, test or exercise (YYYY-MM-DD)

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Schedule and hold a fire drill; record the date, time and observations

questions.title: Is the list of fire wardens and alternates current for every floor or tenant area?
questions.instructions: Confirm names and contact numbers with tenants.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Update the fire warden list and distribute it

questions.title: Is the list of occupants needing assistance during evacuation current and kept confidential?
questions.instructions: Persons with disabilities who have self-identified; review with tenants at least annually.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Update the list of occupants needing evacuation assistance

questions.title: Has the fire alarm system had its annual inspection and test by a qualified technician, with the report on file?
questions.instructions: CAN/ULC-S536, Inspection and Testing of Fire Alarm Systems.

followUps.title: Date of last review, test or exercise (YYYY-MM-DD)

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Book the annual fire alarm inspection and test

questions.title: Have all deficiencies from the last fire alarm inspection been corrected?
questions.instructions: Check the deficiency list in the last annual report.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Correct outstanding fire alarm deficiencies and keep proof of repair

questions.title: Is the fire alarm control panel showing normal, with no trouble or supervisory signals?
questions.instructions: Check the annunciator and panel display.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Call the fire alarm contractor to clear the trouble or supervisory condition

questions.title: Are the required daily and monthly fire alarm checks recorded in the log book?
questions.instructions: CAN/ULC-S536 daily, monthly and annual requirements.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Resume and record daily and monthly fire alarm checks

questions.title: Are manual pull stations visible, unobstructed and undamaged?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Clear access to or repair manual pull stations

questions.title: Are smoke and heat detectors free of covers, paint, damage or obstructions?
questions.instructions: Construction dust covers must be removed after work.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Remove covers or replace damaged detectors

questions.title: Is the fire alarm monitored by a listed monitoring station, and was the connection confirmed in the last 12 months?
questions.instructions: CAN/ULC-S561 monitoring, where required.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Confirm the monitoring contract and test the signal to the monitoring station

questions.title: Has the sprinkler and standpipe system had its annual inspection and test, with the report on file?
questions.instructions: NFPA 25 as referenced by the NFC.

followUps.title: Date of last review, test or exercise (YYYY-MM-DD)

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Book the annual sprinkler and standpipe inspection

questions.title: Are all sprinkler control valves open and secured (sealed, locked or electrically supervised)?
questions.instructions: A closed valve leaves the building unprotected; check during every visit.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Open and secure the control valve; notify the fire department if protection was impaired

questions.title: Is at least 457 mm (18 in.) of clear space maintained below sprinkler heads?
questions.instructions: No storage up to the ceiling.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Lower or relocate storage to restore sprinkler clearance

questions.title: Are sprinkler heads free of paint, corrosion, damage or anything hung from them?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Replace affected sprinkler heads

questions.title: Is a supply of spare sprinkler heads and the head wrench kept in the spare head cabinet?
questions.instructions: NFPA 13 / NFPA 25.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Restock the spare sprinkler head cabinet

questions.title: Are fire department connections visible, accessible, capped and undamaged?
questions.instructions: Clear of snow, landscaping and parked vehicles.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Clear, cap or repair the fire department connection

questions.title: If there is a fire pump, is it run and tested at the required frequency with records kept?
questions.instructions: NFPA 25: weekly or monthly churn test depending on driver type. Answer N/A if no fire pump.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Resume fire pump testing and record results

questions.title: Are fire extinguishers in their designated locations, mounted, visible and unobstructed?
questions.instructions: NFPA 10.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Replace missing extinguishers and clear access

questions.title: Has each extinguisher been visually inspected within the last month, with the tag or record initialled?
questions.instructions: NFPA 10 monthly inspection.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Complete and record monthly extinguisher inspections

questions.title: Has annual maintenance been done on all extinguishers by a certified technician within the last 12 months?
questions.instructions: NFPA 10 annual maintenance.

followUps.title: Date of last review, test or exercise (YYYY-MM-DD)

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Book annual extinguisher maintenance

questions.title: Are pressure gauges in the operable range, with seals and pins intact?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Recharge or replace extinguishers that are discharged or tampered with

questions.title: Are Class K extinguishers provided in commercial cooking areas?
questions.instructions: Answer N/A if there is no commercial cooking.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Install Class K extinguishers in commercial kitchens

questions.title: Are exit routes, corridors and stairwells clear of storage and obstructions?
questions.instructions: NFC 2.7.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Remove obstructions from exit routes

questions.title: Do exit doors open easily from the inside without a key, tool or special knowledge?
questions.instructions: Check locking hardware and any delayed-egress devices.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Repair or replace exit door hardware

questions.title: Are exit signs lit, visible and in good condition?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Repair or replace exit signs

questions.title: Do stairwell and exit doors close and latch on their own?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Repair door closers or latches on exit doors

questions.title: Are exterior exit discharge areas clear (snow, ice, vehicles, storage) to a public way?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Clear the exit discharge area

questions.title: Are handrails, guards and stair treads in good condition?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Repair handrails, guards or stair treads

questions.title: Are monthly tests of emergency lighting units done and recorded?
questions.instructions: CSA C22.2 No. 141 / NFC.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Resume monthly emergency lighting tests

questions.title: Has the annual full-duration test of emergency lighting been done?

followUps.title: Date of last review, test or exercise (YYYY-MM-DD)

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Book the annual emergency lighting duration test

questions.title: Do emergency lights work when tested and are their lamps and housings undamaged?
questions.instructions: Press the test button on a sample of units.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Repair or replace failed emergency lighting units

questions.title: If there is an emergency generator, is it run under load monthly and serviced annually, with records kept?
questions.instructions: CSA C282. Answer N/A if no generator.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Resume generator testing and book the annual service

questions.title: Do fire doors close and latch fully, and are none wedged or tied open?
questions.instructions: Only approved hold-open devices tied to the fire alarm are allowed.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Remove wedges and repair fire door closers or latches

questions.title: Are fire door labels present and the doors, frames and hardware undamaged?
questions.instructions: NFPA 80.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Repair or replace damaged fire doors or hardware

questions.title: Are fire separations free of holes and unsealed penetrations (firestopping intact)?
questions.instructions: Check above ceilings in service rooms after any trade work.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Seal openings with a listed firestop system

questions.title: Have fire dampers been inspected within the required interval?
questions.instructions: NFPA 80 / NFPA 105. Answer N/A if none.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Book fire damper inspection and repairs

questions.title: Is combustible waste removed regularly, with no build-up in rooms, shafts or loading areas?
questions.instructions: NFC 2.4.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Remove accumulated combustible waste and increase pickup frequency

questions.title: Are flammable and combustible liquids stored in approved containers or cabinets, within allowed quantities?
questions.instructions: NFC Part 4.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Move flammable liquids into approved storage

questions.title: Are electrical, mechanical and sprinkler rooms free of storage?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Remove storage from service rooms

questions.title: Do electrical panels have at least 1 m of clear space in front, with covers and breakers in place?
questions.instructions: CSA C22.1 (Canadian Electrical Code).

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Clear access to electrical panels and replace missing covers

questions.title: Are extension cords used only temporarily, with no daisy-chained power bars?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Remove improper extension cords and power bars

questions.title: Are smoking areas designated away from entrances, with proper non-combustible receptacles?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Designate smoking areas and provide proper receptacles

questions.title: Have kitchen exhaust hoods and ducts been cleaned at the required frequency, with the certificate posted?
questions.instructions: NFPA 96. Answer N/A if no commercial cooking.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Book hood and duct cleaning

questions.title: Has the kitchen fire suppression system been serviced within the last 6 months?
questions.instructions: ULC/ORD-C1254.6 / NFPA 96.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Book kitchen suppression system service

questions.title: Are fire routes clear, marked and signed, with no parking?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Clear the fire route and repair signage

questions.title: Are private hydrants accessible, marked and inspected within the last 12 months?
questions.instructions: NFPA 25. Answer N/A if no private hydrants.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Book the private hydrant inspection and clear access

questions.title: Are the fire department key box and building keys present and current?

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Update keys in the fire department key box

questions.title: Has elevator firefighters’ emergency operation (fire recall) been tested within the last 12 months?
questions.instructions: CSA B44. Answer N/A if no elevators.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Book the elevator fire recall test

questions.title: Have smoke control and HVAC shutdown functions been tested with the fire alarm within the last 12 months?
questions.instructions: Integrated testing, CAN/ULC-S1001. Answer N/A if none.

correctiveActions.taskTitle: Book integrated testing of fire safety systems

questions.title: Assessors
